concepts/agent.title: Agent
concepts/agent.description: A participant that forms its own significance on a kline; three roles: Trainee, Trainer, Supervisor.

concepts/canon.title: Canon
concepts/canon.description: A kline structure where signature = signature_of(nodes), claiming S1 — the signature stands for its nodes.

concepts/cogitation.title: Cogitation
concepts/cogitation.description: The slow path of rationalisation through model traversal that tests a kline's structural claim, emitting proposals for ratification.

concepts/curriculum.title: Curriculum
concepts/curriculum.description: A living structured document owned by the Harness with three sections: objective, approach, and lessons; never rolled back.

concepts/escalation.title: Escalation
concepts/escalation.description: The trainer deferring a proposal to the supervisor when its cogitation yields no reply.

concepts/expectation.title: Expectation
concepts/expectation.description: A scripted kline that enters the slow path (S2/S3) during rationalisation and requires a matching proposal to be satisfied.

concepts/frame.title: Frame
concepts/frame.description: Recognised working context persisted across sessions; monotonic.

concepts/grounding.title: Grounding
concepts/grounding.description: The model's mechanism for realising S1 — either by structure (canon self-grounds) or by LTM residency through ratification.

concepts/identity.title: Identity
concepts/identity.description: A terminal kline structure that is directly decodable (self-referential {S: [S]}), claiming S1 — 'I know this.'

concepts/kline.title: KLine
concepts/kline.description: The fundamental unit of Kalvin's memory: a structure containing a signature (head node) and a nodes list, between which holds a relationship rationalised as Structural Significance.

concepts/kvalue.title: KValue
concepts/kvalue.description: The unit of exchange between participants: a KLine paired with a significance (the sender's assessment).

concepts/misfit.title: Misfit
concepts/misfit.description: A kline structure where the signature does not equal signature_of(nodes); sub-shapes include no-fit (S2), underfit (S2), overfit (S2), and connote/denote (S3).

concepts/mts-multi-token-signature.title: MTS (Multi-Token Signature)
concepts/mts-multi-token-signature.description: A KScript device for representing a multi-token signature via compiler expansion of a multi-character identifier into constituent character identities.

concepts/node.title: Node
concepts/node.description: A structural slot in a kline's nodes list, containing either a Token ID or the signature of another kline.

concepts/proposal.title: Proposal
concepts/proposal.description: A KLine emitted by an agent during rationalisation.

concepts/ratify.title: Ratify
concepts/ratify.description: The action of countersigning a selected proposal, usually performed by the Trainer.

concepts/rational-significance.title: Rational Significance
concepts/rational-significance.description: A participant's measurement of whether a kline's structural claim holds against what Kalvin holds, classified into S1–S4.

concepts/relational-tokens.title: Relational Tokens
concepts/relational-tokens.description: The closed set of KScript tokens (==, =>, >, =, none) declaring how a kline is produced and its provenance intent.

concepts/relationship.title: Relationship
concepts/relationship.description: A single-node misfit ({A: [B]} where A != B) treated as a distinct routing class for reciprocal grounding / countersignature.

concepts/scaffolding.title: Scaffolding
concepts/scaffolding.description: KScript entries providing grounding context; either pre-compiled (by curriculum designer) or reactive (written by supervisor on mismatch).

concepts/signature.title: Signature
concepts/signature.description: The value occupying a kline's head position; also a value other klines hold as nodes to evaluate Rational Significance.

concepts/structural-significance.title: Structural Significance
concepts/structural-significance.description: The significance a kline's structure claims on its own, derived from the signature–nodes relationship alone, without model traversal.

concepts/supervisor.title: Supervisor
concepts/supervisor.description: An agent that resolves escalated proposals, deciding ratify, scaffold, or continue; independent of medium (human or LLM).

concepts/target-significance.title: Target Significance
concepts/target-significance.description: The significance a compiled kline is labelled with — the answer the script asserts the trainee should learn to derive.

concepts/terminal.title: Terminal
concepts/terminal.description: A kline whose structure carries no further decomposition; three shapes: empty nodes, self-referential nodes, and compound-word form.

concepts/trainee.title: Trainee
concepts/trainee.description: The participant under instruction — the rationalising system being trained, using Cogitation.

concepts/trainer.title: Trainer
concepts/trainer.description: The trainer-side peer sharing the trainee's rationalising engine; cogitates over proposals, escalates to supervisor on cogitation-empty.

concepts/unknown.title: Unknown
concepts/unknown.description: A terminal kline structure with empty nodes that claims S4 — the structural form of an ask requesting Identity ratification.

concepts/word-binding.title: Word Binding
concepts/word-binding.description: The association of a single-character KScript signature with a word, resolved through scoped annotations (top-level fill-if-empty, inline unconditional).

entities/auto-tune.title: Auto-Tune
entities/auto-tune.description: Experimental loop where an LLM coding agent tunes Kalvin's rationalisation code by running sessions and editing the significance model.

entities/harness.title: Harness
entities/harness.description: The multi-agent runtime that loads agents as participants and routes role-addressed messages between them.

entities/kalvin.title: Kalvin
entities/kalvin.description: The rationalising system whose entire world is built from klines.

entities/kscript.title: KScript
entities/kscript.description: The language that authors training material by declaring klines and labelling them with Target Significance.

entities/ltm-long-term-memory.title: LTM (Long-Term Memory)
entities/ltm-long-term-memory.description: Persistent knowledge surviving across sessions; a kline in LTM is grounded.

entities/stm-short-term-memory.title: STM (Short-Term Memory)
entities/stm-short-term-memory.description: The lowest tier in the write cascade and Kalvin's event register; empty at session start.
